title: Drop the turn gate's retained cursor columns and context-revision tables at the next planned migration
outcome: Drop the turn gate's retained cursor columns and context-revision tables at the next planned migration
acceptance: Import retires them by name and reports each with its counts, and keeps every record id and link unchanged, as the pre-release migration rule requires
The retention notes in the code, spec §2.7, behavioral-control-plane.md and sqlite-store.md are removed with them

When the next schema change that already needs migration export and import lands, the control_sessions columns confirmed_cursor, tentative_cursor and blocking_watermark and the tables project_context_revisions and agent_context_revisions are removed from the schema
